VALIDATION_ERROR.description: Request shape or field validation failed.

AUTH_REQUIRED.description: A valid user session is required.

FORBIDDEN.description: The authenticated actor is not allowed to perform the action.

TENANT_SCOPE_VIOLATION.description: The object is outside the trusted enterprise/provider scope.

OBJECT_NOT_FOUND.description: The object is absent or intentionally hidden from this caller.

VERSION_CONFLICT.description: The aggregate version changed and must be re-read.

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.description: The same idempotency key was reused with a different payload hash.

RATE_LIMITED.description: The caller must wait for the supplied retry interval.

DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE.description: A required dependency is temporarily unavailable.

CALLBACK_SIGNATURE_INVALID.description: Provider signature, timestamp, nonce or credential binding failed.

CALLBACK_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH.description: A provider business key was replayed with different facts.

ENTERPRISE_INIT_REQUIRED.description: The user does not yet have an initialized enterprise.

ENTERPRISE_REVIEW_REQUIRED.description: Enterprise review is required for this capability.

WHITELIST_REQUIRED.description: The enterprise or user is not in the controlled rollout.

FEATURE_DISABLED.description: The feature flag is disabled for the current scope.

REVIEW_SUBMISSION_CONFLICT.description: An active review already exists for this profile version.

APPROVAL_AUTHORIZATION_DENIED.description: Permission, data scope or separation-of-duty validation failed.

TOOL_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID.description: The short-lived tool authorization is invalid or mismatched.

TOOL_RESULT_VERSION_CONFLICT.description: A tool result version is stale or conflicts with saved payload.

CONSUMER_TRIAL_WHITELIST_REQUIRED.description: The consumer cannot start a new controlled-rollout transaction.

TRIAL_INVITATION_INVALID.description: The trial invitation is invalid, expired or exhausted.

PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE.description: The product/version is not currently sellable.

PRODUCT_SALES_MODEL_INVALID.description: Required sales-model or payee facts are missing or invalid.

PRICE_CHANGED.description: The checkout price differs from the preview.

OUT_OF_STOCK.description: One or more requested SKU quantities are unavailable.

CART_STORE_CONFLICT.description: The cart would contain incompatible stores.

ORDER_STATE_CONFLICT.description: The order is not in a legal state for the command.

PAYMENT_PENDING.description: The existing payment result is still unknown.

PAYMENT_CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE.description: The selected payment channel is unavailable.

INVENTORY_RESERVATION_CONFLICT.description: The inventory reservation conflicts with current order facts.

ORDER_INVENTORY_NOT_COMMITTED.description: Shipment is blocked until committed inventory is confirmed.

AFTERSALE_NOT_ELIGIBLE.description: The order item, amount, deadline or state is not eligible.

REVIEW_NOT_ELIGIBLE.description: The completed order item is not eligible for this review action.

PUBLISHED_SNAPSHOT_VERSION_MISMATCH.description: The immutable product snapshot version does not match.

PUBLISHED_SNAPSHOT_HASH_MISMATCH.description: The immutable product snapshot hash does not match.

DISTRIBUTION_CONTEXT_PENDING.description: Transaction may proceed, but profit distribution remains blocked.

COMMERCE_NOT_ENABLED.description: Commerce is disabled for the current enterprise.

SOURCE_NOT_AUTHORIZED.description: Source acquisition or commercial-use evidence is not authorized.

PRODUCT_REVIEW_REQUIRED.description: The current product version requires review.

INVENTORY_CONFLICT.description: Inventory version, quantity or terminal state conflicts.

INVENTORY_RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND.description: The inventory reservation does not exist in this scope.

COMMAND_IDEMPOTENCY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH.description: The command key was replayed with a different canonical payload.

APPROVAL_REF_REQUIRED.description: A non-null approval reference is required for this action.

MARKETING_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE.description: Trusted enterprise marketing context is unavailable.

SOURCE_LICENSE_MISSING.description: The source record has no valid license/consent evidence.

CONTACT_DETERMINISTIC_DUPLICATE.description: The contact deterministically matches an existing record.

CRM_STAGE_CONFLICT.description: The requested CRM stage transition is illegal.

TOUCH_NOT_AUTHORIZED.description: Consent, purpose, suppression or time policy denies contact.

CALL_CAMPAIGN_NOT_APPROVED.description: The call campaign is not approved for execution.

CALL_ADAPTER_UNHEALTHY.description: The real AI-calling adapter is unhealthy.

CALL_RESULT_INCOMPLETE.description: The provider callback does not contain a complete terminal result.

HUMAN_HANDOFF_REQUIRED.description: Automation must stop and create a human handoff.

ATTRIBUTION_FREEZE_PENDING.description: Attribution resolution is pending and must not be guessed.

CONTENT_VERSION_LOCKED.description: The submitted/locked content version is immutable.

CONTENT_NOT_APPROVED.description: The content/channel version has no valid approval.

PUBLICATION_STATE_CONFLICT.description: The publication state does not allow the requested action.

ASSIGNMENT_UNAVAILABLE.description: No compliant account assignment is currently available.

EXECUTION_STATUS_UNKNOWN.description: External execution status is unknown; blind retry/release is forbidden.

ASSIGNMENT_RELEASE_NOT_ALLOWED.description: The assignment cannot be released from the current execution state.

METRIC_NOT_FOUND.description: The approved metric definition does not exist.

ANALYTICS_DIMENSION_DENIED.description: The requested dimension or expression is not allowlisted.

ANALYTICS_DATA_STALE.description: Required source cutoffs are too stale for this operation.

EXPORT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: The export exceeds row, frequency or field limits.

PROFILE_VALIDATION_FAILED.description: The OPC identity profile failed validation.

OPC_FORBIDDEN.description: The provider does not own or cannot access the OPC object.

DUPLICATE_ACCOUNT.description: The submitted channel account already exists.

ACCOUNT_NOT_USABLE.description: The assigned account is paused, risky, unhealthy or released.

SCOPE_DENIED.description: The requested account-session scope is not allowed.

REPLAY_DETECTED.description: A nonce, one-time grant or provider event was replayed.

ASSIGNMENT_RELEASED.description: The account assignment has already been released.

LEDGER_RULE_NOT_EFFECTIVE.description: No approved effective ledger rule exists for the business time.

LEDGER_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.description: A ledger business key was reused with different immutable facts.

LEDGER_BALANCE_RECONCILING.description: Balance reconciliation blocks withdrawals and adjustments.

QUOTA_INSUFFICIENT.description: No quota or valid 500-fen service-payment source is available.

PUBLICATION_SOURCE_INVALID.description: Publication charge sources are missing, conflicting or invalid.

OPC_FACTS_INCOMPLETE.description: Required effective-publication and assignment facts are incomplete.

POINTS_INSUFFICIENT.description: The enterprise points balance is insufficient.

WITHDRAWAL_PAYOUT_PROFILE_INVALID.description: The payout profile is unverified or belongs to another subject.

WITHDRAWAL_DUTY_CONFLICT.description: Initial and final withdrawal reviewers must be different people.
